description: classifies a Referrer-Policy value against a caller allowlist using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded referrer policy check result before accepting, caching, redirecting, or retrying a caller-supplied web response. Returns normalized web evidence, the computed finding, and an explicit pass or advisory status for Referrer Policy Check as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Evaluates only caller-supplied metadata; it performs no DNS lookup, HTTP request, web search, credential use, or persistent storage.

allowed.description: Allowed supplied to Referrer Policy Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

value.description: Value supplied to Referrer Policy Check; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_referrer_policy_check
